venue.name: Crag X Climbing Gym
venue.description: Crag X Climbing Centre is an indoor rock climbing gym at 769 Pandora Avenue in downtown Victoria, started in 1995 and now in its own building with 15m walls, two bouldering areas and an overhanging lead-only wall. Alongside day passes and memberships it takes booked group sessions, including a one-time school group lesson and a multi-week club series, both listed at ages 12+. Children under 12 are welcome in the gym from opening to 6pm but may only climb with one-to-one supervision by a belay-tested adult, and may not belay. All bookings for groups go through a form on the site.

facility_notes.rain_backup: Entirely indoors — a huge open space with 15m high walls and an air system that completely replaces the air with fresh outside air every 2-3 hours.

restrictions: All minors (under 18) must have a waiver signed by their own parent or legal guardian.
Children under 12 years are welcome in the gym from opening to 6pm every day. Ages 12+ after 6pm.
Under 12: can climb with one-to-one supervision by a belay tested adult from opening to 6pm. No belaying even if experienced.
Must weigh at least 30 lbs to use auto-belays.
Non-Walking Babies: No climbing. Must be supervised, within arms reach at all times by an adult who is not climbing or belaying. Must be in a stroller, car seat or arms.
We require tops, bottoms, and shoes on at all times for hygiene and safety reasons.
venue.hours_notes: Monday 12pm-10pm; Tuesday 10am-10pm; Wednesday 12pm-10pm; Thursday 10am-11pm; Friday 10am-11pm; Saturday 8am-8pm; Sunday 10am-6pm (Closed in July & August). Setting happens on Mondays and Wednesdays, when the gym opens at noon.
venue.seasonal_notes: Holiday hours 2026 published on the hours page: closed New Year's Day, Victoria Day (May 18), Canada Day, Labour Day (September 7) and December 24-25; open 10am-6pm on Family Day, Good Friday, Easter Sunday, BC Day, September 30 and Thanksgiving; open at 12pm on Remembrance Day.

programs.name: School group one-time lesson
programs.description: A 2 hour beginner lesson booked for a school group: putting on a harness, tying knots and managing the rope belay systems, after which the group climbs. Rental equipment for the lesson and two weeks of free entry to the gym are included, though gear is not included in the two-week entry. $69 per person for groups of 6-12 and $59 per person for 13 or more; rates are per person and taxes are extra. Advance booking required through the group booking form. A separate, unpriced 2.5 hour 'Group Beginner Lesson' for general groups is described on the Group Lesson page.
programs.what_children_do: Each student puts on a harness, ties a figure-eight knot and learns to belay a partner from the floor, then takes turns climbing the gym's 15m walls under staff supervision.
programs.our_note: The rate is per student and drops at 13 or more, so a full class costs less per head than a half-group — pin down which tier you are in before you commit. Every child needs a waiver signed by their own parent or guardian, so send those home a week ahead rather than handing them out at the door.
programs.practical_summary: Indoors on Pandora Avenue with all lesson gear included and a two-week free entry pass afterwards. Washrooms, a lunch space, bus parking and the session start times are not published — ask when you book.
programs.extra_fees_note: $59 per person for 13 or more. Gear included in the lesson but not in the two weeks of free entry.
programs.evidence: $69 per person for groups of 6-12. $59 per person for 13 or more.

programs.name: School club session series
programs.description: A series for school groups: a beginner lesson in the first session, then 3 or more climbing sessions at a preset time. $49 per student for the lesson and $20 per student for each climbing session. Skills are reviewed the following week by staff before students climb independently, and shoe and harness rentals are included in the cost of the series. Minimum 6 students, maximum 15. Ages 12+. Rates are per person and taxes are extra; advance booking required.
programs.what_children_do: Students learn to put on a harness, tie the knots and manage a top-rope belay in the first session, have those skills checked the following week, then come back on a set schedule to climb and boulder with staff on the floor.
programs.our_note: Price the whole series, not the lesson — the $49 start plus four climbing sessions lands near $130 a student before tax. The upside is that students who pass the belay test can then use the gym outside the booked times, which is worth flagging to families.
programs.practical_summary: All gear is included for the whole series and the group size is capped at 15, so one class group fits and a grade does not. Washrooms, lunch space, session lengths and which months the series runs are not published.
programs.extra_fees_note: $20 per student for each climbing session after the lesson; the series is the lesson plus 3 or more sessions. Shoe and harness rentals are included in the cost of the series.
programs.evidence: You’ll need a minimum of 6 students to run a series and our maximum is 15 students.

programs.name: Group beginner lesson
programs.description: A 2.5 hour complete beginner lesson for a group: how to properly put on a harness, tie the figure eight knot and belay another climber, after which the group has the skills to pass the Crag X belay test. Two weeks of free entry to the gym are included. Taxes extra; advance booking required. The live page publishes no price, no group size and no age range — an earlier fetch of the same URL returned a cached version carrying '$45 per climber' and '10 climbers minimum', which is recorded in conflicts. The school-specific version of this lesson is priced on the School Groups page.
programs.our_note: This is the general group lesson rather than the school one, and the page currently prices nothing — get the per-person rate and the minimum group size in writing before you plan a budget. It also sets no age floor, so check the child policy first: under-12s cannot belay at all and need one belay-tested adult each.
programs.practical_summary: Two and a half hours indoors with two weeks of free entry afterwards. Price, minimum group size, ages, start times, washrooms and lunch space are all unpublished on this page.
